physicalNotes: Radius 0.52 +/- 0.038 solar radii from Torres et al. 2015, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Kepler-438 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...800...99T/abstract): 361,764 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.544 +/- 0.041 solar masses from Torres et al. 2015, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of Kepler-438 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...800...99T/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3748 +/- 112 K from Torres et al. 2015, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-438 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...800...99T/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
